A '''pilot''' using the callsign '''Nova Leader''' flew a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] and was the leader of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron]]. During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], this [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] participated in the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle for the ''Razor's Kiss'']].<ref name="IF" />
